facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: B2B 早期 founder 强推荐
facts_raw.Funding / Support: US$0; First Round covers housing, food and activities onsite
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: 0% equity; free. Founder pays airfare/transportation to retreat.
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Early founder building a new B2B SaaS company；全球可申请；累计融资少于 US$2M；必须能参加 Sonoma 完整4天。
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 正在做 customer discovery / design partners / founder-led sales；处于 pre-PMF。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 首阶段4天必须全程 Sonoma 线下；后续 mix of in-person and Zoom。
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 无需 relocation；需自行具备赴美参加 Sonoma retreat 的资格。
facts_raw.Deadline / Next Intake: Fall 2026 retreat Sep 27–30; future sessions recur
facts_raw.Public Contact Name: Todd Jackson / Brett Berson / Emery Rosansky / Arielle Jackson
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 正在做新 B2B SaaS / AI-native enterprise company，尚未找到强 PMF；技术 founder 尤其适合；累计融资<US$2M。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: Consumer、硬件、biotech/medtech、累计融资≥US$2M、无法完整参加 Sonoma 4天 retreat。
facts_raw.Notes: Foundshore：资本=0，但 PMF/GTM/network value 很高。不能因为不给钱而低估，也不能把它包装成融资项目。

facts.Foundshore Verdict: Strong fit for early B2B founders.
facts.Funding / Support: US$0; First Round covers housing, food and activities onsite
facts.Equity / Economic Terms: 0% equity; free. Founder pays airfare/transportation to retreat.
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Early founders building a new B2B SaaS company. Global applications accepted; less than $2M raised; full four-day Sonoma attendance required.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Pre-product-market-fit teams conducting customer discovery, working with design partners or founder-led sales.
facts.On-site / Attendance: Full four-day Sonoma attendance initially; subsequent activities mix in-person and Zoom sessions.
facts.Visa / Relocation: No relocation required; participants need lawful entry for the Sonoma retreat.
facts.Deadline / Next Intake: Fall 2026 retreat Sep 27–30; future sessions recur
facts.Public Contact Name: Todd Jackson / Brett Berson / Emery Rosansky / Arielle Jackson
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: New B2B SaaS or AI-native enterprise companies before strong product-market fit, especially technical founders with less than $2M raised.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Consumer, hardware or biotech/medtech companies; companies with at least $2M raised; founders unable to attend the full four-day Sonoma retreat.
facts.Notes: No investment, but potentially substantial product-market fit, go-to-market and network value.
